components.css: .ds-extension-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--blume-border,oklch(.21 .034 263.4 / .141));border-radius:var(--blume-radius,.25rem);background:var(--blume-background,oklch(.949 .007 88.6));color:var(--blume-foreground,oklch(.21 .034 263.4));padding:1.25rem;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 150ms ease}.ds-extension-card:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--blume-muted,oklch(.919 .008 91.5)) 60%,transparent)}.ds-extension-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blume-accent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;font:500 .875rem/1.25 var(--blume-font-mono,ui-monospace)}.ds-card-head strong{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-card-head small{color:var(--blume-muted-foreground);font:inherit}.ds-card-copy{margin-top:.5rem;color:var(--blume-muted-foreground);font:400 .875rem/1.5 var(--blume-font-body,ui-sans-serif)}.ds-card-proof{margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--blume-border);padding-top:.75rem;color:var(--blume-muted-foreground);font:500 .75rem/1.25 var(--blume-font-mono,ui-monospace)}

narrative.overview: Henry Pi Harness pairs a warm paper canvas with ink-navy type and a single utility-blue accent. It reads as a personal, proof-driven place for serious Pi tooling: author identity and a working-session screenshot make it human, while concise sans type, monospaced package names, and thin rules keep it exact. The interface stays quiet through flat, bordered surfaces and sparse color; dark mode preserves the hierarchy on a deep navy work surface.
keyCharacteristics: Warm editorial surface with technical dark-mode continuity.
One blue accent for actions, links, and high-signal metadata.
Geist for readable product copy; Geist Mono for identifiers, versions, and commands.
Flat, rule-led organisation with compact, practical controls.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use utility blue for an action, link, or meaningful state. Do not use it as a general surface color.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospaced type for names users may copy, search, install, or compare.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns separation through a rule or a tonal shift before it earns depth.

dos: Do use warm paper, ink navy, and a single utility blue as the dominant visual language.
Do give package names, versions, and commands a monospaced treatment.
Do use thin rules and generous section gaps to group dense technical information.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and use 2.75rem targets for primary actions and footer links.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, decorative gradients, or interface shadows to make the catalogue feel louder.
Don't use mono for explanatory prose or headings.
Don't make every card or control blue; blue is a decision signal.
Don't replace real product proof with fabricated testimonials, metrics, or imagery.
